steps.title: Swap by Reference
steps.description: Write void swap(int &a, int &b) that swaps two values by reference. Test with int x=10, y=20, print before and after.
hints: void swap(int &a, int &b) { int t=a; a=b; b=t; }
Pass by reference uses & in parameter

verification.failureMessage: Swap x and y using pass-by-reference
